kit.name: Mud Coffin Bind
kit.battleDescription: Heavy mud surges up and hardens around the target, locking them in place.

kit.name: Cyclone Cutter
kit.battleDescription: Whirling blades of wind carve through the air toward the target.

kit.name: Buried Memory Field
kit.battleDescription: Phantom earth swallows the enemy's senses and buries their memory.

kit.name: Hollow Voice Cyclone
kit.battleDescription: A cyclone of hollow voices tears through the enemy and feeds on their pain.

kit.name: Rising Gale Combo
kit.battleDescription: A rising flurry of wind-fast strikes batters the enemy upward.

kit.name: Aerial Blade Fan
kit.battleDescription: A fan of airborne blades fans out and presses the enemy.

kit.name: Iron Sand Burst
kit.battleDescription: A cloud of iron-laced sand detonates outward in a grinding burst.

kit.name: Stone Eye Mirage
kit.battleDescription: The ground seems to twist as a stone mirage clouds the enemy's sight.

kit.name: Stone Needle Volley
kit.battleDescription: Jagged stone needles erupt from the earth in a punishing volley.

kit.name: Swiftblade Attunement
kit.battleDescription: The user's blade sings on the wind, quickening every attribute.

kit.name: Whispering Gale
kit.battleDescription: A whispering wind carries doubt that leaves the enemy exposed.

kit.name: Flicker
kit.battleDescription: The user vanishes and reappears on a nearby open tile.

limitations: Offline synthetic fixtures, not an exact live Rill replay. No unknown custom techniques or gear rolls were invented.

Sustain uses current legal27EP named blade. Separately labeled stress uses observedlegacy33EP,15subscriber slots,synthetic catalog techniques and five2%lifesteal armor rolls; neither is an exact Rill replay.
Planner is bounded own-turn public-state search; no hidden player input or forced health target.
Damage/healing telemetry can net simultaneous recovery within one event; actual HP damage, shield damage and final/minimum HP are separate.
Named before profile reproduces the exact old runtimeProfile generic allocation; identity/rewards are not simulated.
World/clan group bosses and weekly score attack have separate source probes.
